### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **44** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/ui.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**7** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`  _(via completed_at (literal, a string literal in ViewFilterOrGroupSchema; a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx`  _(via completed_at (literal, a string literal in ViewFilterOrGroupSchema; a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/frontend/cli.mdx`  _(via invalid_union (literal, a string literal in reportClaimedFilterElementBranch))_
- `content/docs/frontend/data-objectstack.mdx`  _(via ElementDataSourceSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/frontend/data-source.mdx`  _(via ElementDataSourceSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx`  _(via completed_at (literal, a string literal in ViewFilterOrGroupSchema; a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`  _(via completed_at (literal, a string literal in ViewFilterOrGroupSchema; a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via invalid_union (literal, a string literal in reportClaimedFilterElementBranch))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via is_empty (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via is_empty (literal, a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/ui.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **169** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ea1751bea19c5143153da081c3ed1ac478b21fb7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c234035ac4fcd46718e7e0ab01978818b2b3abf4` — the merge of head `399231dcab526848b0d819f63b7d8039da4dd549` into base `ea1751bea19c5143153da081c3ed1ac478b21fb7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c234035ac4fcd46718e7e0ab01978818b2b3abf4 && git checkout c234035ac4fcd46718e7e0ab01978818b2b3abf4
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ea1751bea19c5143153da081c3ed1ac478b21fb7 399231dcab526848b0d819f63b7d8039da4dd549 && git checkout -B drift-repro ea1751bea19c5143153da081c3ed1ac478b21fb7 && git merge --no-ff 399231dcab526848b0d819f63b7d8039da4dd549

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ea1751bea19c5143153da081c3ed1ac478b21fb7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ea1751bea19c5143153da081c3ed1ac478b21fb7` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读（席位终稿 · head `68b81165`）

- **改了什么：** 视图筛选的规则列表里，多了一种元素：“任一满足”组 `{ any: [规则, ...] }`。组内任意一条规则满足就算命中；列表本身仍是“全部满足”。比如 `[{ any: [状态=未完成, 完成时间在近 7 天] }]`，就能存出“未完成，或者 7 天内完成的”视图。列表视图、页签、页面基础筛选、关联列表、查找选择器这些筛选位置一起获得这种写法。组只能一层，组里是普通规则，每条规则的校验和顶层完全一样。空组会被拒，组里再套组也会被拒；写 `$or`、`or`、`logic` 的，会提示改成 `any`。
- **为什么改：** 现在视图筛选只能“全部满足”，CRM 里很常见的“或”类视图存不下来（HotCRM #27386 第 1 行）。本 PR 只做规格这一半。控制台把组真正翻成查询，在 #28370 做，之后落地。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加不改，现有视图一个字节都不变。⚠️ 在 #28370 落地前，存了组的视图，控制台会忽略这个组，结果是显示的记录比作者想要的多。所以组上标了「已声明、尚未生效」，`os validate` 会提示作者。回退本 PR 即可。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`（`ViewFilterAnyGroupSchema`，以及规则列表元素的联合）；`packages/lint/src/filter-walk.ts`（组内字段引用照样检查）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/view-filter-any-group.test.ts`，应全部通过。
- **需要你做的：** 裁定存法（方案 A，另一个线程在和您讨论），并批准键名 `any`。契约复审 PASS、存法裁定都在案之后才合并。

**席位意见：** 按卡交付方案 A，ACCEPT（车道部分）。键名席位赞成 `any`：没有现成的存法可以沿用。控制台筛选器的 `{ id, logic, conditions }` 是编辑态，`logic` 在列表里只有一个合法值，`id` 是界面行键。`$or` 在视图上不允许，以免出现第二套筛选语言。需要契约复审判断的一点：控制台读取之前，组被**忽略**（结果变宽），而不是**拒绝**。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT (lane part) · card #28020 · 2026-10-31T08:27Z

1. **形态：** 38 files, +1243 / −122 at head `68b81165` (+881 / −46 hand-written), draft, `Fixes #28020` once, `Clause-②: yes (widening)` / `Metadata-protocol: added`, changeset `.changeset/28020-view-filter-any-group.md`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28380`: NOT governed, 1365 lines.
2. **前提实测：** holds on `22ce3d13fe`. `ListView.filter` was `z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema)`, and `ViewFilterRuleSchema` was a strict `{ field, operator, value }` object with no group. The dev measured that no stored any-of spelling exists to mirror: the console builder's `{ id, logic, conditions }` is editing state, and `$or` belongs to `FilterConditionSchema`, which views do not take (the objectui#6206 convergence, `packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array.ts`).
3. **门禁 check-runs：** on `68b81165` at this record: 11 success, 7 skipped, 24 in progress, 0 failed. The seat re-reads them before any landing stroke. Dev: 110 gate commands derived, all 110 exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 unrun (`check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 on the unbuilt workspace, then passed after the full build). Spec 773 files / 22857 tests, plus the lint and metadata-protocol tests. os-dev-report 6541131294.
4. **接受的偏差：**
   - **Key `any`, shape A.** ⛔ Not final until the maintainer rules on the stored shape and approves the name. The coordinator opened a separate analysis thread for the shape; this PR does not land before that ruling.
   - **Planned, and ignored rather than refused until #28370.** The five console readers that turn a view filter into a query (plugin-list `buildEffectiveFilter`, core `convertFiltersToAST`, data-objectstack `objectFilterEntriesToAST`, app-shell `viewFilterFold`, plugin-view `parseSpecFilter`) do not read the group yet. A stored group widens the result until they do. The group's describe carries `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` and the liveness row says so. **For the contract reviewer to judge** whether a picker or related-list filter (where a wider result offers records the author meant to exclude) should wait for #28370, or whether the readers should fail closed in the meantime.
   - **`BlueprintViewSchema.filters` stays flat rules.** Its strict mirror cannot hold the union, and its applier is outside this repo; a code comment says so. The seat agrees.
   - **The related-list ui mirror `ui/packages/types/src/record-components.ts` stays flat**, pinned as the contract minus the group. Widening it changes plugin-detail's prop types, which belongs with the reader in #28370. The seat agrees; noted on #28370.
   - **`dropped-refinements.baseline.json` grows (906 → 942 sites, 244 → 246 schemas).** The rule's refinements moved under the union's first branch, and the group adds its own. This is the ledger's designed path for a new union member, not a weakened rule. **For the contract reviewer to confirm.**
   - **File surface beyond the claim, each forced by a gate:** `validate-preset-comparands.ts`, `validate-page-field-bindings.ts`, `metadata-diagnostics.ts`, and six `ui/packages/types` parity tests.
5. **范围外去向：** the console query build and the related-list mirror → #28370. **`Skills-docs:`** owed with #28370, not here: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` should teach `{ any }` only once a console applies it, since teaching a planned filter would teach authors a filter nothing applies. The seat adds that note to #28370.
6. **落地条款：** Tier S path. Owed before any landing stroke: green CI on the landing head; a same-shape `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS (`packages/spec/src/**` non-test); the maintainer's ruling on the stored shape and approval of the key `any`; and `origin/main` merged (main is 7 commits ahead, `git merge-tree` clean). This seat cannot serve that tier now and hands the review over below.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `68b811655830245edb343e45ed08b7b2590d131a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts (`VIEW_FILTER_ANY_GROUP_KEY`, `ViewFilterAnyGroupSchema`, `ViewFilterElementSchema`, `isViewFilterAnyGroup`, `reportClaimedFilterElementBranch`, the `stripRowDecorations` row-carrier read, `ListView.filter` and `ViewTab.filter`), packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts (`ElementDataSource.filter`, the record binding filter, `InterfacePageConfig.filterBy`), packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts (the eleven component doors), packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts (the flat `filters` comment), packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array.ts and packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts (prose), packages/spec/liveness/view.json, packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json and the five generated surface files, packages/lint/src/filter-walk.ts (`filterGroupRules`, the `[i].any[j]` step), validate-page-field-bindings.ts, validate-preset-comparands.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts (`computeViewReferenceDiagnostics`), the six ui/packages/types parity pins, the four new test files, .changeset/28020-view-filter-any-group.md

Inputs: card #28020 (shape A, one group element inside the existing list; the seat's claim and the dev report 6541131294), PR #28380 (body with the key-spelling argument and the acceptance notes, the seat's hand-off 6541148881 with its two questions for this tier, the file list of 38 files, the diff of 1365 lines against `main` read whole, 8 commits from the merge-base a878ff6c), the 70 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T08:49Z: all 70 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Auto Label, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), UI Published Artifacts), the tree at the merge-base for `ViewFilterRuleSchema` (a strict `field`, `operator`, `value` object with the operator fold and the comparand refinements) and the carriers that held `z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema)`, `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts` (`LIVENESS_PLANNED_PROPERTY`, the warning `os validate` gives a planned property), `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` on today's `main` (it walks through `walkFilterFieldKeys`, so it inherits the group step), and the ui consumers of `ViewFilterRule` on `main` (plugin-list `buildEffectiveFilter`, core `convertFiltersToAST`, data-objectstack `objectFilterEntriesToAST`, app-shell `viewFilterFold`, plugin-view `parseSpecFilter`, the pickers and related lists). The head is mergeable and clean against today's `main` (merge-tree clean); `view.zod.ts` moved on `main` since the merge-base in other hunks (the kanban block of #28343 among them), so the landing head is a merge of `main`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **One vocabulary, one level, inside the list** - right. The group is a strict object whose only key is `any`, holding a non-empty array of `ViewFilterRuleSchema` itself, so the operator fold, the operator-value coupling and the `icontains` comparand check run inside a group exactly as at the top level (pinned). The list still ANDs every element. No `$or`, no `FilterConditionSchema` on a view, so the objectui#6206 convergence (one filter language on views) holds; the OR spellings an author might reach for (`$or`, `or`, `anyOf`, `logic`, `conditions`) are answered with the group shape, and a group inside a group is refused with guidance.
- **Byte-identical for every stored filter** - right. The element union carries a check that, on a refused element, splices in only the claimed branch's issues (the own-`any`-key predicate decides the branch; only when the issue sits at the element root and the union has its two branches), so a refused flat rule shows the codes, paths and messages it showed before and never an `invalid_union`; an accepted flat rule parses to the same output as a bare rule (both pinned). The wire `id` strip and the authoring refusal of `id` hold inside a group.
- **Every carrier moved, and the one that did not says why** - right. `ListView.filter`, `ViewTab.filter`, the three page carriers and the eleven component doors now take `ViewFilterElementSchema`; a source scan over `packages/spec/src` pins that no `z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema` remains except `BlueprintViewSchema.filters`, whose strict mirror cannot carry a union and whose applier is out of this repo. Flat there is the right call: a blueprint is the model's authoring face, not a stored view.
- **Readers in `packages/` step into groups** - right. `filter-walk.ts` walks `[i].any[j]` and exports `filterGroupRules`, so the list-view, dataset and widget field-reference rules (including `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`, which moved on `main` but reads through the same walk), the page binding rule and the preset-comparand rule check a field inside a group at its real path and never report `any` as a field; `computeViewReferenceDiagnostics` reads preset-tab filters through a group, and `graftNormalizedOperators` is structural and now pinned through one. No server-side reader in `packages/` turns a view filter into a query, so nothing on the server mis-applies a group.
- **Planned, declared as planned** - right. The group's describe, its TSDoc and `liveness/view.json` carry `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`, naming the five console readers and the console half #28370. That is the repo's door for a declared-before-read property, and `LIVENESS_PLANNED_PROPERTY` makes `os validate` warn an author who stores one, so the lag is visible at authoring time, not discovered at render.
- **The baseline growth is the designed path** - confirmed. `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` grows from 906 to 942 sites and 244 to 246 schemas because the rule's refinements now sit under the union's first branch (`...filter.element.options[0]`) and the group adds its own; no refinement is dropped and no rule weakened.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every run on this head completed and none is red, cancelled or in progress at the read.

### ② Semver level

- **`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor** - accepted. A new accepted element shape on served view, page and component keys is a widening on the metadata protocol: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added` are right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Name `any` and the stored shape are the maintainer's** - the PR does not land before Tesla rules shape A (one any-of group element inside the existing list) and approves the key `any`. The seat's reasoning for the spelling is sound: no at-rest any-of spelling exists to mirror, the console builder's `logic` and `id` are editing state, and `$or` would open a second filter language on views. Flagged, not owed by the dev.
- **Ignored rather than refused until #28370** - judged: declared-planned with the lint warning is the right interim, not a fail-closed reader. A refusal would have to live in five console readers that this PR does not touch, would turn a saved view into a render error for the one author who stored a group, and would be removed again by #28370. The widening is bounded: a picker or related-list filter with a group offers more records than the author meant, it never hides any. The condition is that #28370 lands promptly after this PR; the related-list ui mirror (`record-components.ts`) is pinned as the contract minus the group so the lag cannot drift unnoticed.
- **The conversion registry does not write groups** - right to leave: converting a stored `$or` record into a group would widen that conversion beyond the card.
- **`Skills-docs` owed with #28370** - agreed; `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` teaches `{ any }` once a console applies it.
- **Landing head is a merge of `main`** - `view.zod.ts` and `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` moved on `main` in other hunks; merge-tree is clean, so no delta is expected, and a conflict-free merge keeps this record current.
- **The seat lands** - no Tier H path (no `docs/adr`, no `skills/**`, 1365 lines), no human gate beyond the ruling above.

### ④ Design judgment

- Tried: a group whose rules name the same field twice (two rules, OR semantics, fine); a group holding a rule with a legacy operator alias (the fold runs inside, pinned); an empty list beside a group (list-level rules unchanged); a stored view read back by the console builder (`parseSpecFilter` reads flat rules only, so a group is a row the builder cannot show, which is #28370's first job and worth naming there). Keying the branch on the one key `any` is what keeps the stored-rule face byte-identical. Nothing to add.

**Verdict reasoning.** The group is one element kind inside the one filter list, with the rule schema reused whole so nothing is checked twice or differently, every stored filter parses and refuses byte-identically, every carrier moved with a pin holding the set, every reader in `packages/` steps into groups, the planned lag is declared where authors and the lint see it, the declarations and the minor level are right, and every check is green or skipped. The name and the shape stay the maintainer's to rule before landing.
